title: DeepAVR: Deep Analysis via Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Vulnerability Repair
title_zh: DeepAVR：基于多智能体协作的深度分析与自动化漏洞修复

paragraphs.en: 提出多智能体框架DeepAVR，通过深度诊断反馈迭代修复漏洞，在VulnLoc上正确补丁率达92.3%。 Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR) has emerged as a critical defense against software security flaws, aiming to triage and fix bugs autonomously. Early LLM-based approaches focused on patch generation under the assumption of perfect fault localization, while recent end-to-end methods attempt to repair vulnerabilities directly from sanitizer logs. However, these methods often fail when the root cause is deeply hidden--either physically distant from the crash site or logically masked by interdependent errors--making the initial report insufficient. We propose DeepAVR, a multi-agent framework for end-to-end AVR that performs deep analysis by transforming intermediate repair outcomes into structured diagnostic feedback. DeepAVR decomposes repair into specialized roles--Fault Localization, Patch Generation, Compile Validation, Security Validation, Functionality Validation, and Patch Review--and routes feedback across these roles to iteratively refine both localization and patch hypotheses. In particular, DeepAVR introduces patch-conditioned re-localization, which treats execution results from intermediate patches as diagnostic signals to uncover hidden root causes, and a root-cause-oriented patch review stage that detects symptom-level fixes and incomplete repairs beyond execution-based validation. Evaluation on the real-world C/C++ vulnerability repair dataset VulnLoc shows that DeepAVR significantly outperforms prior methods, generating correct patches for 92.3% of vulnerabilities. Furthermore, results on SAN2VULN demonstrate strong generalization, with DeepAVR effectively repairing vulnerabilities unseen during training.
paragraphs.zh: 提出多智能体框架DeepAVR，通过深度诊断反馈迭代修复漏洞，在VulnLoc上正确补丁率达92.3%。自动化漏洞修复（AVR）已成为抵御软件安全缺陷的关键防线，旨在自主地对漏洞进行分类并修复。 早期基于大语言模型的方法在假定故障定位完美无误的前提下专注于补丁生成，而近期的端到端方法则尝试直接依据净化器日志修复漏洞。 然而，当根本原因深藏不露时——即与崩溃位置在物理上相距甚远，或在逻辑上被相互依赖的错误所掩盖——这些方法往往会失败，使得初始报告不足以支撑修复。 我们提出DeepAVR，这是一个用于端到端自动化漏洞修复的多智能体框架，它通过将中间修复结果转化为结构化的诊断反馈来执行深度分析。 DeepAVR将修复过程分解为多个专门角色——故障定位、补丁生成、编译验证、安全验证、功能验证和补丁审查——并在这些角色之间传递反馈，以迭代地改进定位结果和补丁假设。 特别地，DeepAVR引入了以补丁为条件的重新定位机制，该机制将中间补丁的执行结果视为诊断信号，以揭示隐藏的根本原因；同时引入了面向根本原因的补丁审查阶段，能够检测出超出基于执行验证范围的表象级修复和不完整修复。 在真实世界C/C++漏洞修复数据集VulnLoc上的评估表明，DeepAVR显著优于先前的方法，为92.3%的漏洞生成了正确补丁。 此外，在SAN2VULN上的结果表明其具有强大的泛化能力，DeepAVR能够有效修复训练中未见过的漏洞。
